inputs.name: K3_elliptic_genus_factor_k
inputs.why: Z_K3(tau,z) = k*phi_{0,1}(tau,z) with k=2 typed (this was `twoB` in v2 theta_forms.py:135). Everything downstream that uses c(D) = k*cB(D) depends on it. FROM MEMORY / standard (Eguchi-Ooguri-Tachikawa; DMVV normalisation). Cross-checked, not derived, against Track D chi in part1_euler_numbers.py.

inputs.name: DMVV_product_formula
inputs.value: sum_N p^N chi(Sym^N X; q,y) = prod_{m>0,n>=0,l} (1 - p^m q^n y^l)^(-c(nm,l)), c(n,l)=coefficient of Z_X
inputs.why: Dijkgraaf-Moore-Verlinde-Verlinde generating function; typed structural input. For K3 the coefficients depend only on D=4nm-l^2 (index 1), c(nm,l)=c(4nm-l^2). FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: Jacobi_theta_definitions
inputs.why: standard definitions (Eichler-Zagier / DMZ); typed. Checked by computation: index-1 D-dependence, q^0 terms y-2+1/y and y+10+1/y. FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: Sym_k_Euler_numbers_comparison_formula
inputs.why: Goettsche's formula, used only as the comparison target with chi(S) taken from Track D exports. FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: immortal_ansatz_form
inputs.value: Delta*psi_1 = G_2/A = N*A_{2,1} + c*E4*A - M*Hhat(tau,z), A_{2,1}=sum_s q^{s^2+s} y^{2s+1}/(1-q^s y)^2 (|q|<|y|<1), Hhat = sum_{n,l} H(4n-l^2) q^n y^l
inputs.why: DMZ mock-Jacobi decomposition ansatz (polar Appell-Lerch term + mock Eisenstein Hhat + holomorphic term); the FORM is typed, the three coefficients (N,c,M) are SOLVED. FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: weak_Jacobi_ring_monomials
inputs.value: weight-0 index-m weak Jacobi forms spanned by E4^i E6^j A^a B^b with a+b=m, -2a+4i+6j=0
inputs.why: Eichler-Zagier structure result: ring of weak Jacobi forms of even weight is polynomial in A,B over M_*(SL2Z). The monomial list is typed; coefficients are solved exactly; rank and residual are reported. FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: Hurwitz_H0
inputs.why: H(0) convention for Zagier's Eisenstein series; not obtainable by counting. Used only in Hhat's n-l^2 = 0 terms. FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: Kronecker_Hurwitz_relation
inputs.why: classical class-number relation used only as external structural check of the H table. FROM MEMORY.

inputs.name: Track_D_chi_K3
inputs.why: chi of the resolved Kummer surface, read at run time from Track D exports.json (v3 if present else v2); this line records the value at authoring time, scripts re-read the file.

inputs.name: DMZ_5_16_coefficients_for_comparison
inputs.why: FROM MEMORY / v2 note (arXiv:1208.4074 eq. 5.16 as recorded in v2). NOT used in any computation path; only placed in an `expected` field after the solve.

The immortal decomposition for m>=2 (needs A_{2,m} plus extra mock pieces) was not done.
Track D exports.json was read from the v3 D-tda directory as found at run time (a parallel track, status: depends on declared local-model inputs); rerun part1_euler.py if it changes.
k_norm=2 is a typed input; the check chi=k*12=24 against Track D is a cross-check, not an independent derivation of 24.
